# Enterfind Server — AI coding instructions

This project keeps **one** set of instructions, for every AI assistant, at:

**[`.claude/skills/enterfind-server.md`](../.claude/skills/enterfind-server.md)**

Read it before making changes. `CLAUDE.md` includes the same file, so Copilot and Claude Code work
from identical guidance.

Keeping a second copy here is what let this file drift — it described Spring Boot 3.5 long after the
project moved to 4.1. Add new guidance to the file above, not to this one.
